versions.changelog:
- Initial release of exa-web-search-nodeskai.
- Offers AI-powered web, code, and company research with no API key required.
- Supports core tools for web search, code context (from GitHub/Stack Overflow), and company research.
- Provides optional advanced tools for deeper domain/date-filtered search, profile lookups, and research agents via configuration.
- Simple setup and usage instructions included.
